metadata.title: A Lesson in Options Trading From Our Failed Walmart Bet<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
What We Learned From a Volatile Walmart Trade
Our primary analytical mistake was overconfidence in management’s expense discipline. We also overestimated consumer spending resilience.
In late May, Walmart seemed like an opportune buy.
